title: The Missing Moonseed

segments.title: Follow the Light
segments.objective: Gather the golden Lumen ribbon and meet Neri.

segments.title: Relic Fork
segments.objective: Choose the risky outer current for the Moonseed Fragment.

segments.title: Rescue Miri
segments.objective: Swim through three Rescue Lights to free the baby manta.

segments.title: Race Neri
segments.objective: Hold Flow, avoid collisions and reach the final marker first.

segments.title: Duskmaw Appears
segments.objective: Pass through three Current Breaks to widen the escape gap.

segments.title: Return to the Moon Well
segments.objective: Reach the ceremonial Moonseed portal and restore its light.
